title: S 级核心词 · 第 27 组
objectives: 认识并会读这 40 个高频词：点 🔊 音标听发音，跟读一遍
记住每个词的**中文意思**和**英文释义**，并用近义词、反义词把意思连成一片
在例句短文里认出这些词，体会它们在句子里的语气（褒、贬、中性）

items.zh: （情绪）善变的，易变的，反复无常的，活泼的，机敏的，水银的
items.en: changing mood or mind quickly and unpredictably
items.root: Mercury 墨丘利/水星，行动迅速、水银易流动 → 善变的

items.zh: 打败，征服，战胜，克服（情感），击败
items.en: to defeat thoroughly
items.root: vinc/vanq(征服) + -ish → 打败

items.zh: 慷慨，慷慨的馈赠，慷慨赠予，（尤指对不如自己的人）施舍
items.en: generosity in giving money or gifts
items.root: larg(大) + -esse → 大方 → 慷慨的赠与

items.zh: vt. （使）焦躁，激怒，使恼怒；n. 胆汁，厚脸皮，恶毒，磨损；刺痛，擦伤
items.en: to irritate or annoy; bold rudeness

items.zh: 虚构的事物，幻觉，空想，妄想，怪物，狮头羊身蛇尾怪物
items.en: an illusion or fanciful idea that cannot be achieved

blocks.text: The [[mercurial]] king would [[vanquish]] a foe one day and show [[largesse]] the next; his heir came to [[gall]] the court, for the throne was a [[chimera]].

items.zh: 反对的，不愿意的，厌恶的，嫌恶的（常与 to 连用）
items.en: strongly opposed or disinclined
items.root: a-(ab 离开) + vers(转) → 转身避开 → 反对的

items.zh: 困惑，窘境，进退两难，为难，困境
items.en: a state of uncertainty over what to do

items.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的，秘密的，偷偷摸摸的，（动作）隐秘的，诡秘的
items.en: secretive and trying not to be noticed
items.root: furt(偷，←fur 贼) + -ive → 偷偷摸摸的

items.zh: 缓和，减轻（痛苦、困难等），缓解，使（痛苦）易于忍受
items.en: to make pain or a problem less severe
items.root: al-(ad 向) + lev(轻) + -iate → 使变轻 → 减轻

items.zh: 固执的，倔强的，顽固的，（疾病）难治的，（问题）难以解决的
items.en: stubbornly refusing to change
items.root: ob-(对着) + stin(站，←stare) + -ate → 站着不动 → 固执

blocks.text: He was [[averse]] to the [[quandary]] of a [[furtive]] deal; he tried to [[alleviate]] the tension, but the [[obstinate]] partner refused.

items.zh: 充满…的，富于…的，装满的，吃饱的（常与 with 连用）
items.en: filled or well supplied
items.root: re-(再，加强) + plet(满) → 充满

items.zh: 引出，激起，唤起，诱出（答案、反应等），（逐步）获得，探出
items.en: to draw out a response, reaction, or fact
items.root: e-(出) + lic(引诱) + -it → 引出

items.zh: vt. 使（品质）污损，玷污，使变质，污染；n. 污点，腐败，污染，（道德上的）污点
items.en: to spoil or contaminate with something bad

items.zh: 傲慢的，专横的，自负的，过分自信的，过分的
items.en: excessively confident or proud

items.zh: 特权，权力，（尤指因地位而有的）特权，专有权利
items.en: a right or privilege belonging to a person or group
items.root: pre-(前) + rog(问，请求) + -ative → 先被征询投票的人 → 特权

blocks.text: The room was [[replete]] with notes that could [[elicit]] a reply; a leak might [[taint]] the [[overweening]] boss, who guarded his [[prerogative]] fiercely.

items.zh: 追捧，把…捧为名人，把…当作名流，崇拜
items.en: to treat as a celebrity
items.root: lion(狮子) + -ize(使) → 把…当狮子捧

items.zh: 易受影响的，容易受伤害的，易受感染的，易感的，敏感的，可能的（常与 to 连用）
items.en: easily affected or influenced
items.root: sus-(sub 下面) + cept(拿，接受) + -ible → 能被拿住的 → 易受影响

items.zh: vt. 促进，鼓励，培养，抚育，领养（非亲生子女）；adj. 收养的，寄养的
items.en: to encourage the growth of; to nurture

items.zh: 稍纵即逝的，短暂的，飞逝的，转瞬即逝的
items.en: lasting a very short time
items.root: flee(←fly 飞，逃) + -ing → 飞逝的

items.zh: 汇集，交汇于一点，（趋于）会合，趋同，（观点）一致，聚于一点
items.en: to come together at a point
items.root: con-(共同) + verg(倾斜，转向) → 一起转向 → 汇聚

blocks.text: Fans would [[lionize]] the star, who was [[susceptible]] to praise; his trainer chose to [[foster]] humility, for fame is [[fleeting]] and the paths soon [[converge]] on obscurity.

items.zh: （技术、设备或原料等的）全部本领，全部节目，全部技能，（艺人的）保留剧目，（可供使用的）技能，库存
items.en: the range of works or skills a person can perform
items.root: re-(再) + pert(找到，←parire 产生) + -oire → 能拿出的东西

items.zh: （信仰上）虔诚的，虔敬的，虚伪的，（常含贬义）装虔诚的，（尤指道德上）假装高尚的
items.en: devoutly religious; sometimes hypocritically virtuous
items.root: pi(敬重，←pius) + -ous → 虔诚的

items.zh: 自恋的，自我陶醉的，过分自爱的，自我欣赏的
items.en: having excessive interest in oneself
items.root: Narcissus 那喀索斯(爱上自己倒影的美少年) + -istic → 自恋的

items.zh: 不妥协的，固执的，不让步的，强硬的，不肯通融的
items.en: unwilling to change one's views or compromise
items.root: in-(不) + trans(穿过) + ig(←agere 驱赶) + -ent → 不肯过去 → 不妥协

items.zh: 间接的，暗讽的，反手的，表面恭维实则讽刺的
items.en: indirect and insincere; an ambiguous compliment
items.root: back(反) + hand(手) + -ed → 反手打的 → 间接的、暗讽的

blocks.text: The singer's [[repertoire]] was [[pious]], but his [[narcissistic]] and [[intransigent]] manager gave a [[backhanded]] compliment to the press.

items.zh: 刻意避开，戒绝，避免，（有意）避开
items.en: to deliberately avoid or abstain from

items.zh: 可信的，似乎有理的，貌似真实的，说得通的，（人）花言巧语的
items.en: seeming reasonable or probable
items.root: plaus(鼓掌赞同) + -ible → 能让人鼓掌的 → 似乎有理

items.zh: 笨拙的，不雅的，难看的，不灵活的，（动作）不优美的，笨重的
items.en: awkward in movement or form

items.zh: 引起，使发展，产生，导致，造成，使发生
items.en: to cause or give rise to a feeling or situation
items.root: en-(使) + gener(生) + -ate → 使产生

items.zh: n. 取代者，替代品，代用品，代替人；vt./vi. 取代，替代，代替
items.en: a person or thing that takes the place of another
items.root: sub-(下面) + stitu(放，站) + -te → 放在下面顶替 → 替代

blocks.text: The critic chose to [[eschew]] a [[plausible]] but [[ungainly]] theory that could [[engender]] debate; no [[substitute]] was offered.

items.zh: 探究，钻探，深入研究，（在口袋等里）搜寻，挖掘
items.en: to search deeply into something

items.zh: 加固，使安全，巩固，合并，统一，加强，整合
items.en: to make stronger; to combine into one
items.root: con-(加强) + solid(坚固) + -ate → 巩固

items.zh: vt. 使缓和，使适度，节制；adj. 适度的，中庸的，温和的，中等的；n. 温和派
items.en: to make less extreme; not extreme
items.root: moder(尺度，适中) + -ate → 使适度

items.zh: 摈弃，拒绝，断然拒绝，（轻蔑地）拒绝，不屑
items.en: to reject with disdain

items.zh: 多余的，冗余的，累赘的，被裁减的，不必要的，（词语）冗长的
items.en: not needed because it repeats something
items.root: re-(再) + und(波浪，涌) + -ant → 满溢出来的 → 多余的

blocks.text: The team agreed to [[delve]] deeper; the firm wished to [[consolidate]] its power and [[moderate]] its tone, but it would [[spurn]] a [[redundant]] rule.

items.zh: 炫耀，神气，气派，（尤指行为的）优雅，自信，风采，（帽上的）羽饰
items.en: stylish confidence and flair

items.zh: 校验，证实，核实，验证，（通过检查）确认
items.en: to check that something is true
items.root: ver(真) + -ify(使) → 证实

items.zh: 不结实的，松弛的，软弱的，软的，无力的，缺乏活力的
items.en: soft and limp; lacking vigor
items.root: flacc(松软，←flaccus) + -id → 松弛的

items.zh: 讽刺，用讽刺诗文抨击，嘲讽
items.en: to criticize or mock through humor and irony
items.root: satir(讽刺，←satura 杂烩) + -ize → 讽刺

items.zh: adj. 自制的，禁欲的，苦行的，朴素的；n. 禁欲者，苦行者
items.en: living a strict, self-denying life; one who does so

blocks.text: Her [[panache]] won the room; she would [[verify]] each claim, since a [[flaccid]] case could [[satirize]] itself, and an [[ascetic]] monk agreed.

questions.explain: fleeting：稍纵即逝的，短暂的，飞逝的，转瞬即逝的（lasting a very short time）。近义词：brief, ephemeral。
lionize：追捧，把…捧为名人，把…当作名流，崇拜（to treat as a celebrity）。近义词：celebrate, glorify。

questions.q: 哪个词的意思是「虚构的事物，幻觉」？
questions.explain: chimera：虚构的事物，幻觉，空想，妄想，怪物，狮头羊身蛇尾怪物（an illusion or fanciful idea that cannot be achieved）。

questions.q: 哪个词和 **shun** 的意思最接近？
questions.explain: eschew 与 shun 近义：to deliberately avoid or abstain from。

questions.q:
选最适合填入空格的词：

> The singer's repertoire was ____, but his narcissistic and intransigent manager gave a backhanded compliment to the press.
questions.explain: pious：（信仰上）虔诚的，虔敬的，虚伪的，（常含贬义）装虔诚的，（尤指道德上）假装高尚的（devoutly religious; sometimes hypocritically virtuous）。
